# Congresswoman Joyce Beatty

> Official website of U.S. Representative Joyce Beatty serving Ohio's 3rd Congressional District, providing constituent services, legislative information, and news.

This is the official House office website for Congresswoman Joyce Beatty, representing Ohio's 3rd District. The site serves constituents with information about her legislative work, committee assignments, and comprehensive constituent services including federal agency assistance, grant applications, military academy nominations, and internship opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Joyce Beatty
- Ohio 3rd District
- Constituent Services
- Congressional Office
- Federal Grants
- Military Academy Nominations
- Press Releases
- Congressional Committees
- Legislation and Voting Record
- Internships
- Federal Agency Assistance
- The Beatty Bulletin
- Artistic Discovery Contest
- Congressional Commendations
- Presidential Greetings

## About Congresswoman Beatty

- [Homepage](https://beatty.house.gov): Homepage for Rep. Joyce Beatty representing Ohio's 3rd Congressional District
- [Full Biography](https://beatty.house.gov/full-biography): Full biographical information about Congresswoman Joyce Beatty
- [About Rep. Joyce Beatty](https://beatty.house.gov/about/about-rep-joyce-beatty): Biographical profile and overview of Rep. Joyce Beatty
- [Committees and Caucuses](https://beatty.house.gov/about/committees-and-caucuses): Committee assignments and caucus memberships for Rep. Beatty
- [Ohio 3rd District](https://beatty.house.gov/about/our-district): Information about Ohio's 3rd Congressional District with map

## Constituent Services

- [Services Hub](https://beatty.house.gov/services): Constituent services hub including grants, nominations, internships
- [Help with a Federal Agency](https://beatty.house.gov/services/help-federal-agency): Casework assistance resolving issues with federal agencies
- [Grant Applicants](https://beatty.house.gov/services/grant-applicants): Resources and assistance for federal grant applications
- [Military Academy Nominations](https://beatty.house.gov/services/military-academy-nominations): Nominate constituents for U.S. Military Academy appointments
- [Appropriations Requests](https://beatty.house.gov/services/appropriations-requests): Submit federal funding appropriations requests for district projects
- [Internships](https://beatty.house.gov/services/internships): Apply for internship positions in Rep. Beatty's offices

## Legislative Work

- [Votes and Legislation](https://beatty.house.gov/about/votes-and-legislation): Rep. Beatty's voting record and legislative activities

## Media and News

- [Media Center](https://beatty.house.gov/media-center): Media center hub with press releases and news updates
- [Press Releases](https://beatty.house.gov/media-center/press-releases): Official press releases from Congresswoman Beatty's office
- [The Beatty Bulletin](https://beatty.house.gov/media-center/beatty-bulletin): Newsletter with news on Rep. Beatty's work in Ohio and Capitol
- [In the News](https://beatty.house.gov/media-center/in-the-news): News coverage and media mentions of Congresswoman Beatty

## Optional Services

- [Events](https://beatty.house.gov/about/events): Upcoming events and public appearances by Congresswoman Beatty
- [Commendations and Greetings](https://beatty.house.gov/services/commendations-and-greetings): Request Congressional Commendations or Presidential Greetings
- [Art Competition](https://beatty.house.gov/services/art-competition): Artistic Discovery Contest for high school students in district
- [Flags](https://beatty.house.gov/services/flags): Order U.S. flags flown over the Capitol through Rep. Beatty
